assumptions: 'Success rate' means attempt-level success rate: successful attempts divided by all attempts, with each retry counted as a separate attempt. Order-level and technical rates are shown alongside.
Period analysed: 1 August 2026 to 31 August 2026, UPI payments only.
caveats: Success rate depends on the denominator: attempt-level 93.11%, order-level 95.5%, technical 96.82%. Retries and drop-offs explain the gap.

8.0% of Meridian Bank's card attempts in August 2026 (2,856 of 35,507) are missing issuer IDs, so issuer-level results for that scope are understated. These rows were kept and shown as '(missing)' issuer, not corrected. This does not affect the UPI figure above.

facts.text: UPI attempt success rate for 1-31 August 2026 was 93.1%: 184,077 successful attempts out of 197,696 attempts.
Under other definitions, the UPI order-level success rate was 95.5% (181,222 of 189,760 orders) and the technical success rate was 96.8% (184,077 of 190,115 attempts).
The three definitions differ by up to 3.71pp for UPI in August (93.1% attempt-level vs 96.8% technical).
The data-quality scan found one warning: 8.0% of Meridian Bank's card attempts in August 2026 (2,856 of 35,507) have no issuer ID. These are card attempts, not UPI.

response.headline: The UPI attempt success rate in August 2026 was 93.1%, with 184,077 successful attempts out of 197,696.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Compute the share of UPI orders with more than one attempt and the share of those that ended in success.
hypotheses.rationale: Attempt-level counts every retry as a separate attempt, so failed first tries lower the attempt rate, while the order-level rate only asks whether the order eventually succeeded. The order-level rate is higher, which is consistent with retries.
hypotheses.text: The gap between the attempt-level rate (93.1%) and the order-level rate (95.5%) is likely driven by customers retrying failed UPI payments and eventually succeeding.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The three definitions differ by up to 3.71pp for UPI in August (93.1% attempt-level vs 96.8% technical).
recommendations.rationale: The rate moves by up to 3.71pp depending on the denominator, so unlabelled comparisons can mislead.
recommendations.text: Quote the UPI success rate together with its definition (attempt-level 93.1%) when sharing it, and show the order-level 95.5% alongside for context.

recommendations.linked_fact_or_hypothesis: The gap between the attempt-level rate (93.1%) and the order-level rate (95.5%) is likely driven by customers retrying failed UPI payments and eventually succeeding.
recommendations.rationale: This would confirm or rule out the retry explanation for the gap between attempt-level and order-level rates.
